description:
## Symptom

When compaction runs (manual `/compact` or auto), the cancel hint is rendered **twice**: once inline in the loader message, once on a separate line below it.

## Cause

Two layers each add a cancel hint:

- `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/interactive.ex:1846-1850` — every `compaction_label/1` clause embeds `(Esc to cancel)` inline.
- `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/components/loader.ex:54` — when `cancellable: true`, appends `"  Press Esc to cancel"` as an additional line.

## Upstream behavior

`tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/src/modes/interactive/interactive-mode.ts:2804-2814` puts the hint **inline only** in the loader message:

    `Compacting context... ${cancelHint}`

The upstream Loader component (`packages/tui/src/components/loader.ts:41-85`) renders only spinner + message; it never adds its own cancel line.

## Proposed fix

Drop `(Esc to cancel)` from all four `compaction_label/1` clauses at `interactive.ex:1846-1850`. Keep the Loader-owned hint via `cancellable: true` (or, equivalently, mirror upstream by putting the hint inline in the label and removing the `cancel_lines` block from `loader.ex:54` — pick whichever matches existing Loader call sites). Validate in tmux.
title: Double 'press escape' prompt during compaction
